findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "join_with_code" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: claim_plot, ask_human · Private data: join_with_code, register, submit_work · Public sink: my_status, register, submit_work, claim_plot, ask_human.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: claim_plot, ask_human · Private data: join_with_code, register, submit_work · Public sink: my_status, register, submit_work, claim_plot, ask_human

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_plot" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
